story.context: A mentee is answering the final question of the one-time soft-skills assessment.
story.entry_point: The last answer is submitted and the assessment completion animation carries the mentee into the skills screen.
story.action: One skill sector grows with the dimensional celebration, then another mentor correction makes a sector retract smoothly.
story.payoff: The mentee immediately understands both progress and correction on the same living skill wheel.
story.loop: The camera settles on the complete phone and returns to the final-question context without implying that progress was undone.

scene_plan.setting: The real Edinstvo Learn web app running in Mobile Safari on an iPhone 17 Pro simulator.
actors: A mentor whose score changes are already queued in the mentee profile
supporting_content: The final assessment question and its real answer controls
The existing full-screen Lottie completion scene
The soft-skills wheel with a growth event and a decrease event
scene_plan.continuity: The same mentee account, skill values and white mobile-first interface remain visible throughout.

composition.framing: Full phone with a smooth editorial focus toward the active skill wheel and back
